_note: FULLY curated merge-adjudication cases (Phase 76; SUPERSEDE Phase 79; regeneration-only — .venv/bin/python scripts/curate_merge_cases.py). TWO SCORED populations, kept visibly separate by oracle PROVENANCE (Phase 79 supersede: BOTH are synthetic and BOTH are scored — the prior consensus-vs-scored split retired now that the real-substrate population has a non-circular oracle): (1) 29 REAL-SUBSTRATE candidate SHARES from aml-substrate's --anchored --emit-eval-oracles slice (@c099259, Phase-32/33 anchored fork) — scored against substrate's OWN latent GT-<hash> identity oracle (NON-circular: GT != entity_ref, so the Phase-77 circular-oracle abort is CURED). The demoted spine (email/phone weak — Phase-75's noise floor) refuses every candidate; the oracle reveals which are real fragment co-references it MISSED (uphold_merge) vs noise-floor collisions it correctly refused (reject_as_shares). SUPERSEDES the Phase-76/77 consensus-66 (which had no oracle). (2) 13 hand-authored SYNTHETIC scored cases from data/entity-spine/true_entities.json — spanning all 4 quadrants / 3 bases. BOTH populations' latent truth rides ONLY each case's `oracle` block (revealed post-disposition); the pre-disposition evidence (a/b) carries no truth field (the resolver-input firewall). Shared emails are domain-masked to example.test (the local-part token kept, proving the exact collision). Illustrative; no catch-rate/lift/precision is claimed; every scored number is synthetic-only-qualified.

adjudication_grades.desc: These records are the SAME entity — confirm the merge the resolver proposed (or should have).
adjudication_grades.label: Uphold the merge

adjudication_grades.desc: Distinct entities that merely share an identifier — keep them apart; record the link as a SHARES edge, not a merge.
adjudication_grades.label: Reject — keep distinct (a SHARES edge)

adjudication_grades.desc: The evidence genuinely underdetermines it — record the ambiguity instead of forcing same-or-distinct.
adjudication_grades.label: Both defensible

adjudication_grades.desc: Insufficient to call either way — route to expert / await more identifiers.
adjudication_grades.label: Neither — escalate
